Provident Real Estate proudly presents this modern 1-bedroom apartment for rent in Zada Tower, Business Bay. Situated on a high floor with a pleasant pool view, this Fully furnished unit offers a functional layout and contemporary finishes, making it ideal for professionals seeking a vibrant and well-connected city lifestyle.


  Unit Details:


  Type: 1 Bedroom Apartment
  Bathrooms: 1
  Size: 457 sq. ft
  Floor: High Floor
  View: Pool View
  Furnishing: Fully furnished
  Living Area: Open-plan layout with large windows and good natural light
  Kitchen: Modern fitted kitchen
  Wardrobes: Built-in wardrobes
  Parking: 1 Allocated Parking Space
  Status: Vacant


  Building Amenities – Zada Tower:


  Swimming Pool
  Fully Equipped Gymnasium
  Landscaped Outdoor Areas
  Lobby and Lounge Area
  24/7 Security
  Covered Parking
  High-speed Elevators


  Prime Location – Business Bay:


  Located in the heart of Business Bay
  Minutes away from Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall
  Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road
  Close to restaurants, cafes, and retail outlets
  Well-connected to major business and lifestyle destinations
